case: numeric[] exact text through JSON, CSV, XLSX and SQL file writers
contract: A numeric[] contains a 40-digit integer, a high-scale decimal, 1.2300, NaN, positive/negative Infinity and SQL NULL; PostgreSQL type, canonical array text and array_to_json provide native oracles.
The driver presents quoted numeric array elements; binding that text back as numeric[] reproduces native array_to_json and array_send exactly.
JSON, CSV and XLSX file writers preserve the driver's exact array text as text, with XLSX using a string cell and no formula.
Replayed SQL file output restores the canonical array text, JSON elements and wire bytes.

native_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres value_contract_numeric_array_file_exports_preserve_exact_text -- --ignored --nocapture

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL array families and file-writer combinations, spreadsheet application re-import, and additional enum configurations remain open.
